title: RepoHealthRawRecord
description: One raw-data snapshot for a single SourceCraft repository, produced by the Data Collector. This is INPUT to the scoring service, not the score itself: category blocks carry facts and counts, not a 0-100 number. Any field can be null when the underlying source was unavailable for this run -- always check collection.category_status before trusting a category block.

repo.description: Repository identity and metadata. Fields here are facts, not signals -- they don't feed the score directly.

platform_id.description: SourceCraft internal gitRepo ID or public UUID, when known.

collection.description: Metadata about THIS collection run: what succeeded, what didn't, and why. This is what lets downstream consumers (scoring service, dashboard) tell 'repo is unhealthy' apart from 'we couldn't reach a data source'.

category_status.description: 'ok' = fully collected, 'partial' = some fields missing, 'unavailable' = source unreachable/unauthorized, 'not_applicable' = e.g. security add-on not needed for this repo.

documentation.description: Git-native: cloned repo tree inspected directly, no platform API needed.

readme_has_sections.description: Which of [installation, usage, license, contributing, api] were heuristically detected as headings.

cicd.description: Config presence is git-native (reads .sourcecraft/ci.yaml from the clone). Run-history fields are platform-API-sourced and MAY be null with pipeline_history_available=false if that endpoint isn't reachable yet -- see config/endpoints.yaml (list_pipeline_runs, verified:false).

security.description: Sourced from the SourceCraft Security (AppSec) API. For public repos, scan results are available without connecting the Security Add-on, per organizer guidance (2026-09-19). String enum values (severity, status, scan type) are passed through as returned by the API; the draft spec explicitly warns the *numeric* forms of status/severity are undocumented, so we never touch those.

appsec_available.description: false when the AppSec API was unreachable/unauthorized/not applicable for this repo.

defect_groups_by_severity.description: severity string (as returned by the API, e.g. CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) -> count of currently open defect groups.

defect_groups_by_status.description: Raw status string (as returned by the API, e.g. RESOLVED_FP) -> count. The draft spec does not enumerate the full status list, so we pass through whatever strings the API gives us rather than assume which ones mean 'open'.

open_defect_groups_total.description: Heuristic: count of groups whose status does NOT contain 'RESOLVED'. Cross-check against defect_groups_by_status once the full status enum is confirmed.

has_security_policy.description: git-native: SECURITY.md presence in the clone.

activity.description: Git-native (commit graph of the shallow clone) plus platform-API pull/merge-request stats.

bus_factor_top1_share_365d.description: Share of commits_365d authored by the single most active contributor -- a simple concentration-risk proxy, not a full bus-factor model.

likes.description: Aggregate repo rating, sourced from get_repo's embedded `rating` field (confirmed 2026-09-19 against the live Redoc docs -- NOT the `.../rating` sub-resource, which is the current user's own reaction). `value` is SourceCraft's own composite rating score (based on user reactions -- 👍/❤️/💎, weighted low/medium/high -- plus other unpublished factors); observed range so far is roughly 0-100+ (e.g. 0, 54.5), exact scale/derivation is not documented, do not assume it's normalized. `percentile` is a PERCENTAGE NUMBER on a 0-100 scale (e.g. 2 means top 2%), not a 0-1 fraction -- corrected 2026-09-20 after a real repo returned percentile=2 and failed schema validation against an earlier (wrong) assumption of a 0-1 fraction; matches the doc wording literally ('рейтинг составляет 15%' = the field holds 15, not 0.15). It is also INVERTED versus normal percentile intuition: per sourcecraft.dev/portal/docs/ru/ (Опенсорс > Рейтинг и реакции), LOWER percentile = BETTER/higher-ranked repo (percentile 2 is near the very top, not the bottom). The field is entirely absent from get_repo's response for repos with zero reactions (not present as null) -- code and schema both treat that as `percentile: null`.

percentile.description: 0-100 scale (percentage points), lower is better -- see parent description.

code_health.description: Git-native static scan of the cloned working tree (no execution, no third-party linters -- that's AppSec's job).

oldest_todo_age_days.description: best-effort, via git blame on matched lines; omitted when too slow for repo size.
